source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why does turning a one-time skill into a persistent process require additional failure testing?

options.text: Repeated execution repairs errors by retrying the unchanged procedure
options.feedback: Repetition can reproduce the same error, so define failure behavior and test it before relying on unattended runs.

options.text: Saved progress eliminates the need to check whether required inputs are present
options.feedback: Saved state supports continuity, but later runs can still encounter missing inputs or access.

options.text: An available execution host establishes that every requested action is appropriate
options.feedback: Host availability enables operations; allowed actions and verification criteria still need to be defined.

options.text: An unattended process can repeat the same error across runs
options.feedback: Persistent operation adds opportunities for recurring mistakes. Test failure cases and define when the process should stop.
